description:
This tool calls the Actor "industrial_platform/sitemap-intelligence" and retrieves its output results.
Actor description: Discover and expand sitemaps into crawl URLs. Price: $0.0001 per emitted URL.

This tool requires an x402 payment. Include a valid x402 payment signature in the request metadata (_meta["x402/payment"]). Your MCP client must support the x402 payment protocol.

max_sitemaps.description:
Maximum sitemap and sitemap-index documents processed during one run.
Example values: 100
max_sitemaps.title: Maximum sitemap files

max_urls.description:
Maximum unique URL rows emitted and charged during one run.
Example values: 50000
max_urls.title: Maximum URLs

start_urls.description:
**REQUIRED** Domains, website URLs, or direct sitemap URLs. Domains use robots.txt discovery plus /sitemap.xml fallback.
Example values: ["https://www.google.com/gmail/sitemap.xml"]
start_urls.title: Domains or sitemap URLs

timeout_seconds.description:
Maximum time allowed for each robots.txt or sitemap request.
Example values: 30
timeout_seconds.title: Fetch timeout

waitSecs.description: Max seconds (0–45, default 30) to cap the wait for the Actor run to reach terminal state. For long-running Actors the response returns at the cap with the current run status; follow `nextStep` to poll via get-actor-run. Set to 0 to fire-and-forget.

name: industrial_platform--sitemap-intelligence

nextStep.description: One primary follow-up action with identifiers interpolated

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the run started

status.description: Run status: READY | RUNNING | TIMING-OUT | TIMED-OUT | ABORTING | ABORTED | SUCCEEDED | FAILED

storages.description: Dataset and key-value store metadata, keyed by alias. "default" is always the primary entry.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

datasets.description: Map of dataset alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary dataset.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the dataset; present only for Console sessions

fields.description: Dataset field paths in dot notation (e.g. ["metadata.url"])

inflatedBytes.description: Approximate uncompressed byte size of the dataset. Use with itemCount to pick limit/fields before fetching.

itemsSchema.description: JSON Schema for rows in the dataset at `storages.datasets.default.id` — describes row shape only; the rows themselves are NOT returned inline in this response. Inferred from this Actor's historical successful runs. To fetch actual rows, call `get-dataset-items` with the dataset id and a `fields` projection drawn from this schema.

keyValueStores.description: Map of key-value store alias → metadata. Key "default" is always the run's primary store.

apifyConsoleUrl.description: Personalized Apify Console link to the store; present only for Console sessions

keyCount.description: Total number of keys (omitted when truncated)

level.description: Omitted when the Actor wrote an unrecognized level
